name: Lou de K
description: Lou de Kerhuelvez works on machine consciousness and more broadly frontier technology development. She is Vice President and Program Director at the California Institute for Machine Consciousness (CIMC), which asks whether machines can be conscious—and whether we can build them that way. She also founded Nodes, an agency for frontier tech projects, and is a co-builder of Feÿtopia, an experimental community instantiated each winter in a French château. Her broader interests include decentralized institutions, ethics, political philosophy, philosophy of mind, and new approaches to governance and coordination.
